grounded.observation: Current host snapshots and visibility-filtered objects; integer tiles; six inventory slots.
grounded.structure_alive: For structures objectAlive means exposed; positive HP means standing.

predicates.candidate_exists: The current scan selected an observed attackable enemy.
predicates.inventory_has_empty: An empty slot was seen during the earlier inventory scan.
predicates.no_candidate: No candidate was observed; no assertion about unseen enemies.

situation.notes: Hosted replay evidence uses published game 2026.9.10.3. Hidden state reconstructed for offline diagnosis is not available to the policy.

grounded.lifetime: BASIC globals start at zero per episode and persist across decisions and respawns. join_wave revalidates an escort by observed living ID whenever selected.
grounded.uncertainty: Unseen enemies are unobserved. Tower targets and enemy intentions are not exposed.

B_equipment.claim: The hosted v1 diagnostic ended with only one or two equipment items per hero and repeated poison purchase attempts. Removing poison purchases may allow equipment growth and improve fort wins; healing/mana spending may still limit saving.

B_local_gate.claim: Frozen BASIC b32ca7b56d081017bfd253601c292e0823869fcf94e5f0dd1328171d15f78cdd failed_local_gate: 112/240 candidate wins versus 115/240 matched baseline wins, across 24 independent seeds with all ten seats tested separately. Paired gain -0.0125; seed sign-test p=0.820358, alpha=0.025, required gain=0.1. This measures the complete configuration among nine default policies. It does not isolate individual changes or establish wider-field strength.

G_fort.preference: Team fort victory is the terminal evaluation objective. Timeouts score zero.

G_base.preference: Count decisions and attack the nearest observed eligible enemy. Separate rules specify fallback movement and spending.

G_capacity.preference: Keep baseline healing and mana support while preserving gold for persistent equipment growth by omitting poison purchases.

G_center.preference: Return to the baseline central destination when no eligible enemy is observed.

change.description: Scope active beliefs and goals to the frozen configuration. Historical wave hypotheses remain in ancestor artifacts. BASIC unchanged.
